verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that the Conductor API can 'read metrics and audit logs' and that the Conductor console can monitor workflows. That is a pull-based building block a developer could use to construct an export, not a documented export of failure rates, latencies, or queue depths to an external observability stack. Nothing in the pack documents alerting on misbehaving workflows.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, failure rates, latencies, and queue depths export to my observability stack, and alerts fire when workflows misbehave
